# Settings

> Every setting the *Sonic Pi for VS Code* extension contributes, with its type, default and allowed values, generated from `package.json` `contributes.configuration`.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sonicpi.osc.host` | `string` | `"127.0.0.1"` | IP address of the Sonic Pi server. |
| `sonicpi.osc.sendPort` | `number` | `4557` | UDP port to send OSC commands to. Range: 1 to 65535. |
| `sonicpi.osc.listenPort` | `number` | `4558` | UDP port to listen for server responses. Range: 1 to 65535. |
| `sonicpi.osc.daemonPort` | `number` | `0` | Port for keep-alive messages (0 = auto-discover). Range: 0 to 65535. |
| `sonicpi.autoConnect` | `boolean` | `true` | Automatically connect to Sonic Pi when a .spi file is opened. |
| `sonicpi.heartbeatInterval` | `number` | `2000` | Milliseconds between keep-alive heartbeats. Range: 500 to 10000. |
| `sonicpi.sonicPiPath` | `string` | `""` | Path to Sonic Pi installation (empty = auto-detect). |
| `sonicpi.audioInputs` | `boolean` | `false` | Open audio inputs on the Sonic Pi audio server (needed for live_audio). Off by default: requesting the microphone from VS Code triggers a macOS permission prompt and can silence output when input/output sample rates differ. Restart the daemon after changing. |
| `sonicpi.logLevel` | `string` | `"info"` | Minimum log level to display in the Sonic Pi Log. Allowed:<br>`"debug"`: Show all messages including internal debug output.<br>`"info"`: Show user output, cues, syncs, and errors (default).<br>`"warning"`: Show warnings and errors only.<br>`"error"`: Show errors only. |
